## reporting_period

The product name and report type were not provided, but the reporting period was from 2024-12-27 to 2025-12-26.

## narrative_summary

During the reporting period, 1024 cases were received, of which 1023 (99.9%) were serious and 1023 (99.9%) met 15-day alert criteria. Cases were most concentrated in the 75+ age group, among female patients, and in eu. Acute kidney injury was the most frequently reported reaction overall and among serious cases. The most common outcome was recovered/resolved. Case volume rose to 35 during the week of 2025-06-22, above the normal range."tstiing edit"

## summary_analysis_of_cases

The total case volume was 1024, with 1023 cases classified as serious and 1023 as alert, representing 99.9% of all cases. The cases were distributed across different age groups, with 248 cases in the 18-64 age group, 266 in the 65-74 age group, 408 in the 75+ age group, 16 under 18, and 86 unknown. By sex, there were 503 female cases, 493 male cases, and 28 unknown. The cases also varied by country, with the most reported in eu (342 cases), france (185 cases), and the united kingdom (278 cases). In terms of seriousness criteria, 68 cases resulted in death, 105 were life-threatening, 482 involved hospitalization, 44 were disabling, 7 were congenital anomalies, and 905 were classified as other. The outcome counts showed 494 cases recovered or resolved, 329 with unknown outcomes, 226 recovering or resolving, 194 not recovered or not resolved, 68 fatal, and 21 recovered or resolved with sequelae. The cases were reported by various sources, including 115 from consumers or non-health professionals, 162 from other health professionals, 255 from pharmacists, and 492 from physicians.

## reaction_ae_analysis

The top reactions overall were Acute kidney injury with 80 cases, Drug ineffective with 54 cases, and Hypotension with 46 cases. Among serious cases, the top reactions were also Acute kidney injury with 80 cases, Drug ineffective with 53 cases, and Hypotension with 46 cases. In the 18-64 age group, Drug ineffective was reported 25 times, which was the highest count for this age group. Among females, Acute kidney injury was reported 32 times, which was the highest count for this sex. System Organ Class level analysis was not available for this dataset.

## serious_cases_15day

There were 1023 alert cases, which accounted for 99.9% of the total cases. The most common reactions among these alert cases were Acute kidney injury with 80 occurrences, Drug ineffective with 53 occurrences, and Hypotension with 46 occurrences. The most common outcomes among the alert cases were recovered/resolved with 494 occurrences, unknown with 328 occurrences, and recovering/resolving with 226 occurrences. Expectedness (labelled/unlabelled status) could not be assessed, as no product label was supplied for this exercise.

## trends_observations

The week of 2025-06-22 recorded 35 cases, above the normal range of 7.14 to 30.86. No periods were flagged below the normal range, as the dips dataset was empty. The normal range for this dataset's case volume per period was between 7.14 and 30.86, with a median of 19.0.

## history_of_actions

No history of safety-related actions was supplied for this reporting exercise.
